scope: All 135178 vertices and 324044 edges of the archived author graph. Independent pooled-edge statistics on clipped fitness, not a reproduction of an unprinted Fig. S22 coefficient. The exact plotting input is unavailable; preprocessing variants are deliberately separate.
preprocessing: Read full measured unrounded fitness fixture, align by exact sequence to the archived directed edge list, retain largest author component exactly. Floor fitness at -0.507774 before computing differences, matching the author graph-weight convention. For DRI use source fitness, for ICI use target fitness and reverse the edge; response is positive target minus source. Each edge has equal weight; Pearson, average-tie-rank Spearman, OLS with intercept. No subsampling, log conversion, inference test, RNG, missing values or zero edges.

sources.locator: Supplementary Fig. S22 B-C, p.42: individual beneficial effects vs background and OLS line; N=324044, no printed slope/r. Graph convention: supplementary network methods pp.14-15.
